term: commission: reported commission versus Jesus' commissioning
resolution: The five report statements (STMT-REPORTED-MATT-16-CHURCH-ON-ROCK-KEYS-BINDING, STMT-REPORTED-MATT-18-CHURCH-JUDGES-DISCIPLES-BIND, STMT-REPORTED-MATT-COMMISSION-GROUNDED-IN-GIVEN-AUTHORITY, STMT-REPORTED-JOHN-20-SENDING-FORGIVE-RETAIN, STMT-REPORTED-JOHN-21-PETER-SHEPHERD) use the textual sense: what a Gospel says Jesus gave (DEF-COMMISSION-REPORT-POWERS). STMT-COMMISSION-REPORTS-GO-BACK-TO-JESUS uses both senses and is the only bridge between them: it asserts that the event (Commissioning.Gave, DEF-COMMISSION-EVENT-AND-GOVERNING-POWER) happened for the powers the reports name. STMT-CHURCH-FOUNDED-IN-COMMISSIONED-APOSTLES uses only the event sense. No step passes from a report to an event except through that report-to-event premise, and the substance of a commission (its powers) is meant, not its wording.
